gbm_population_evidence.quote: Subjects must be pathologically confirmed to have high-grade glioma, defined as WHO (2021) Central Nervous System Tumor Classification grade 3 or 4 gliomas; or primary central nervous system lymphoma (PCNSL).
This group includes a variety of histological types, most commonly glioblastoma, anaplastic astrocytoma, anaplastic oligodendroglioma, and primary central nervous system lymphoma.

gbm_population_flag.reason: Glioblastoma named only in brief summary; eligibility says WHO 2021 grade 3 or 4 high-grade glioma, which would include GBM but does not name it.

candidate_evidence.quote: CHT101 is an allogeneic CD70-targeted chimeric antigen receptor Tcell therapy, intended to be administered locally for the treatment of primary malignant brain tumors.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: in Adult Subjects With Recurrent or Progressive Malignant Primary Brain Tumors

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Pharmacodynamics (PD): Concentration levels of serum cytokines, such as IL-2, IL-4, IL-6, IL-10, IFN-γ, TNF-α

role_evidence.quote: CHT101 is an allogeneic CD70-targeted chimeric antigen receptor T cell therapy.

agents.drug_class_hint: CHT101, allogeneic CD70-targeted CAR-T cell therapy, locally administered

source_quote.quote: Tumor tissue specimens must be CD70-positive as determined by immunohistochemistry (IHC).

coder_notes: CD70-targeted CAR-T (cell therapy) is the only intervention, so no pharmacological candidate regardless of S5. CD70 eligibility is mechanistically linked to the CAR-T, but CAR-T is an excluded intervention type, not a candidate, so candidate_matched false. PK/PD outcomes concern the CAR-T (non-candidate); PK sample type not stated. cns5 because eligibility cites WHO (2021) CNS classification.
